description:
Use this when the user asks for NSE's own market cap and shares in issue, for one company over time or the largest companies on a day.

NSE's own market capitalisation, shares in issue and face value, from the daily PR bundle.

    With `symbol`: that security over `days` (default 30) or `from_date`/`to_date`. Without it: the
    `limit` (1..100) largest by market cap on `date` (default newest day) plus NSE's published listed,
    permitted and total market cap for the day. `market_cap` is rupees as NSE published it; it is not always
    issue size x close and is not corrected. History starts 2024-02-01. Facts as published, no valuation
    view.
name: get_market_cap_history
title: NSE market capitalisation
